note: Which county row offices a county elects, by state. A state with no row for an office takes the common pattern for that office (every county elects one), marked estimated. A row marked read cites the page it was read from; a row marked estimated is the common pattern or general knowledge not yet read from the state's own law and is meant to be upgraded by research, one state at a time, without a code change. Counties in Connecticut and the territories hold no governing function in the game's county list, so they are never asked. County charters can override a state row; none has been read.
